BHU Banaras Hindu University BHU has released the advertisement of School Teacher TGT, PGT, PRT and Principal Recruitment 2024. All the candidates who want to apply in this BHU Teaching Recruitment can apply Online from 13 June 2024 to 19 July 2024 . See advertisement for other recruitment related information like syllabus, Subject Wise Vacancy, qualification, age limit, selection procedure.
Banaras Hindu University (BHU) BHU TGT, PGT, PRT, Principal in School Teaching Recruitment 2024 BHU Advt. No. : 24/2023-2024 :  Short Details of Notification WWW.SARKARIRESULT.COM

Important Dates Application Begin : 13/06/2024 Last Date for Apply Online : 19/07/2024 upto 05 PM Pay Exam Fee Last Date: 19/07/2024 Submit Form Hard Copy : 24/07/2024 Exam Date : 13-15 September 2026 Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee For Principal Post : General / OBC / EWS : 1000/- SC / ST : 0/- All Category Female : 0/- For TGT, PGT, PRT Post : General / OBC / EWS : 500/- SC / ST : 0/- All Category Female : 0/- Pay the Exam Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI Fee Mode Only.

The downloaded application form along with the enclosures must be sent to the Office of the Registrar, Recruitment & Assessment Cell, Holkar House, BHU, Varanasi -221005 (U.P.) on or before 17.07.2024

How to Fill BHU School Teacher Teacher Recruitment 2024 Online Form Banaras Hindu University BHU School Teacher TGT, PGT, PRT and Principal Recruitment Notification 2024 and Invited Online Application Form for the BHU RAC Jobs 2024 Candidate Can Apply Online for 13/06/2024 to 19/07/2024. Candidate Read the Notification Before Apply the BHU Latest Teaching Recruitment Exam 2024 Application Form in Sarkari Result Recruitment Latest Job Section. Kindly Check and Collect the All Document – Hand Writing, Eligibility, ID Proof, Address Details, Basic Details. Kindly Ready Scan Document Related to Recruitment Form – ID, DOB Proof, Etc. Live Photo and Hindi / English Signature Required in BHU Online Form 2024. Before Submit the Application Form Must Check the Preview and All Column Carefully. If Candidate Required to Paying the Application Fee Must Submit. If You have Not the Required Application Fees Your Form is Not Completed. Take A Print Out of Final Submitted Form.
